name: 27409 · Greensboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27409 (Greensboro) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27409 (Greensboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27409 (Greensboro) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
